# Fonrex Documentation

> Official technical documentation for Fonrex — Open-source financial data infrastructure API.

Fonrex provides high-performance self-hosted financial data pipelines, TimescaleDB time-series storage, real-time WebSocket streaming, valuation & DCF engines, technical indicators, and multi-provider consensus monitoring.

## Core & Getting Started

- [Introduction](/docs/intro): High-level introduction to Fonrex financial data infrastructure.
- [Installation](/docs/getting-started/installation): Step-by-step setup guide for local and production environments.
- [Configuration](/docs/getting-started/configuration): System parameters, database credentials, and environment flags.
- [First API Call](/docs/getting-started/first-api-call): Making your first authenticated REST API request.
- [Docker Compose](/docs/getting-started/docker-compose): Multi-container deployment with PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, and Redis.

## API Reference

- [Assets & Listings](/docs/api-reference/assets): Tickers, ISINs, exchanges, asset metadata, and search endpoints.
- [Fundamentals](/docs/api-reference/fundamentals): Income statements, balance sheets, cash flow series, and financial ratios.
- [Historical Prices](/docs/api-reference/historical): OHLCV time-series queries, resampling, and intraday data endpoints.
- [Realtime Streaming](/docs/api-reference/realtime): WebSocket and Server-Sent Events (SSE) live data stream specs.
- [Technical Indicators](/docs/api-reference/technical-indicators): Moving averages, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, and custom calculations.
- [Valuation & DCF Engine](/docs/api-reference/valuation-dcf): Discounted Cash Flow, WACC estimation, and intrinsic value endpoints.
- [News & Sentiment](/docs/api-reference/news): Financial news aggregation, article extraction, and sentiment scoring.
- [Health & Monitoring](/docs/api-reference/monitoring): Provider consensus status, validation logs, and system health checks.
- [Specialized Data](/docs/api-reference/specialized): Crypto, Foreign Exchange (FX), macroeconomics, and commodities endpoints.

## Guides & Tutorials

- [Import Assets](/docs/guides/import-assets): Bulk asset onboarding and ticker symbol mapping workflows.
- [Ingest Historical Data](/docs/guides/ingest-historical-data): Pipeline setup for historical data backfilling.
- [Configure Realtime](/docs/guides/configure-realtime): Realtime websocket subscription and multiplexing guide.
- [Backtesting with Zipline](/docs/guides/backtesting-zipline): Integrating Fonrex data pipelines into Zipline and Python backtesters.
- [Adding Data Providers](/docs/guides/adding-providers): Implementing custom provider adapters with hexagonal architecture.

## Architecture & System Design

- [System Overview](/docs/architecture/overview): High-level system topology, domain boundaries, and data flows.
- [Hexagonal Architecture](/docs/architecture/hexagonal): Ports & Adapters design pattern, domain isolation, and interface specs.
- [Data Model & Schema](/docs/architecture/data-model): PostgreSQL relational schemas and TimescaleDB hypertables design.
- [Database Migrations](/docs/architecture/migrations): Alembic migration policies, schema versioning, and zero-downtime rules.
- [Concurrency & Locking](/docs/architecture/concurrency): Async IO concurrency, Redis locks, rate limiters, and job queues.

## Data Providers

- [Providers Overview](/docs/providers/overview): Supported market data, fundamentals, and news providers list.
- [Fundamentals Providers](/docs/providers/fundamentals-providers): SEC EDGAR, Yahoo Finance, FMP, and custom adapters.
- [News Providers](/docs/providers/news-providers): NewsAPI, Benzinga, SEC RSS feeds, and crawler setup.
- [Adding Custom Provider](/docs/providers/adding-custom-provider): Step-by-step developer guide for adding new provider modules.

## Monitoring & Reliability

- [Validation Layer](/docs/monitoring/validation-layer): Data sanity verification, anomaly detection, and consensus rules.
- [Canary Monitor](/docs/monitoring/canary-monitor): Automated synthetic API probes and provider availability tracking.
- [Alerts & Webhooks](/docs/monitoring/alerts): Configuring Slack, Discord, email, and custom webhook alerts.

- [Environment Variables](/docs/deployment/environment-variables): Complete reference of all configurable ENV parameters.
- [Database Migrations Deployment](/docs/deployment/database-migrations): Production database deployment and rollback procedures.
- [Production Checklist](/docs/deployment/production-checklist): Hardening, backups, health checks, and go-live verification.
